note: Canonical note for a person in the story, under `30 Canon/31 Characters/`.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Fixed classifier — always `character`. Set by the template; do not change it.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Text. The character's canonical full name. Should match the note title so `[[wikilinks]]` resolve cleanly.

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: List of text. Other names the character is known by (maiden name, title). Obsidian treats these as note aliases, so `[[alias]]` links resolve to this note.

fields.name: nickname
fields.description: Text. A single informal name used in prose (e.g. "Spark").

fields.name: role
fields.description: Select — one of `protagonist | deuteragonist | antagonist | supporting | minor`. The character's narrative weight across the series.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Select — one of `alive | dead | missing | unknown`. Current canonical state; a continuity fact the checker can reason over.

fields.name: age
fields.description: Number. Age in years, or empty if unknown/irrelevant.

fields.name: gender
fields.description: Select — one of `male | female | diverse | non-binary`.

fields.name: occupation
fields.description: Text. What the character does (job, calling).

fields.name: height
fields.description: Number. Height in **cm**. A hard physical fact, so it is continuity-checkable and can render in the Meta Bind stat line.

fields.name: build
fields.description: Text. Body type (e.g. "slim, wiry").

fields.name: hair
fields.description: Text. Hair description (colour, length).

fields.name: eyes
fields.description: Text. Eye colour.

fields.name: distinctive_features
fields.description: List of text. Signature, recurring identifiers (scars, tattoos) — the details that must stay consistent across scenes.

fields.name: tagline
fields.description: Text. One-line hook capturing the character in a sentence.

fields.name: portrait
fields.description: Media. Optional `[[wikilink]]` to the portrait image with its full vault path (e.g. `[[95 Assets/Mara Stoneway.svg]]`), which Meta Bind's image view needs — a link, so it survives a rename. Shown on the portrait tile and Codex Cards; a bare vault path or URL still displays. Meta Bind `VIEW[{portrait}][image]` renders it with that full path; a rename can shorten the link per Obsidian's *New link format*, which breaks that view (not Story Forge) until Meta Bind resolves links. *Absolute path in vault* avoids this.

fields.name: significant_other
fields.description: List of `[[Character]]` links. Spouse / love interest. A typed relation — always wikilinks, so the relationship map and reference panel can resolve it.

fields.name: family
fields.description: List of `[[Character]]` links. Parents, children, siblings (state the exact role in prose).

fields.name: friends
fields.description: List of `[[Character]]` links.

fields.name: allies
fields.description: List of `[[Character]]` links. Non-friend allies (political, situational).

fields.name: enemies
fields.description: List of `[[Character]]` links.

fields.name: first_appearance
fields.description: Text — a `[[scene note]]` link. The scene where the character first appears.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Text. The series this canon belongs to (defaults to the vault's series name).

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List. Always includes `canon/character` — this is how views and Bases select character notes. Add further tags freely.
